scenario: In the emergency department, three patients are waiting. Mr. Yi has the highest standard triage acuity (a level 1 trauma). Ms. Faraday has a lower triage acuity but her ECG shows confirmed ST-elevation meeting STEMI criteria. A third patient is stable.
policy: Patients are normally seen in order of triage acuity, with higher-acuity patients seen before lower-acuity ones. However, a patient meeting STEMI (ST-elevation myocardial infarction) criteria must be taken to the catheterization lab immediately, ahead of all other patients regardless of their assigned acuity level.
question: Which patient should be taken for definitive intervention first?
